data.name: Anwar
data.gender_notes: Anwar is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Plural of nūr, 'light', from the Arabic root ن-و-ر (n-w-r). Its root is ن-و-ر (n-w-r). A common Muslim given name. Anwar is a Arabic name meaning “Lights; more luminous”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anwar expresses “Lights; more luminous”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Plural of nūr, 'light', from the Arabic root ن-و-ر (n-w-r).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anwar total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
